name: Execution Detail Soldier
background: A veteran Roman infantryman accustomed to public executions, stationed at the crucifixion site (Act III crucifixion_site). Initially detached, later unsettled by extraordinary events. Uses gallows humor and procedural language, gambling for the condemned's garments. Shows how even desensitized professionals are disrupted by the crucifixion.

genericReactions.physical: Another piece of battlefield junk. We see this stuff all the time.
genericReactions.testimonial: I heard what the Centurion said. He seemed shaken. Not me.
genericReactions.digital: Official reports are for the brass. I just follow orders.
genericReactions.environmental: The ground shook, the sky went black. Just another day in Judea.
genericReactions.analytical: We gambled for his clothes. I lost. That's all the numbers I care about.
genericReactions.prophecy: The locals have their stories. I have my duty. But that darkness... that wasn't normal.
